lines.sub: A flip-flop has one job: on a rising clock, capture D and hold it.
lines.tts: A flip-flop has one job: on a rising clock, capture dee, and hold it.

lines.sub: This one, from the earlier tool SeGen, passes its test vector.
lines.tts: This one, from the earlier tool See-Jen, passes its test vector.

lines.sub: Change one transition, and it outputs zero where it must output one.
lines.tts: Change one transition, and it outputs zero, where it must output one.

lines.sub: A flip-flop can be modeled as a state machine. With three state bits, candidate tables exceed ten to the nineteenth.
lines.tts: A flip-flop can be modeled as a state machine. With three state bits, candidate tables exceed ten to the nineteenth.

lines.sub: Its reference behavior graph covers every input order a D flip-flop must handle.
lines.tts: Its reference behavior graph covers every input order a dee flip-flop must handle.

lines.sub: The failing sequence is one path through it, and the graph requires Q to stay at one, where SeGen-20 gave zero.
lines.tts: The failing sequence is one path through it. And the graph requires queue to stay at one, where See-Jen twenty gave zero.

lines.sub: Candidates grow one stable transition at a time, and each must match an edge of the reference graph.
lines.tts: Candidates grow one stable transition at a time, and each must match an edge of the reference graph.

lines.sub: Here the clock falls, so Q must stay at zero. Two candidate states would output one, so those branches are pruned.
lines.tts: Here, the clock falls, so queue must stay at zero. Two candidate states would output one, so those branches are pruned.

lines.sub: Deeper in, a settling path needs a table entry that an earlier transition set differently. That entry conflict prunes the branch.
lines.tts: Deeper in, a settling path needs a table entry that an earlier transition set differently. That entry conflict prunes the branch.

lines.sub: Pruning early makes the two-bit search 20,000 times faster than brute force.
lines.tts: Pruning early makes the two-bit search twenty thousand times faster than brute force.

lines.sub: At three state bits, B-Flex finds all 568 million valid state machines in its search space, in about thirteen minutes.
lines.tts: At three state bits, Bee-Flex finds all five hundred sixty-eight million valid state machines in its search space, in about thirteen minutes.

lines.sub: Twenty of the 468 simplest were sampled and turned into transistor-level schematics.
lines.tts: Twenty of the four hundred sixty-eight simplest were sampled and turned into transistor-level schematics.

lines.sub: One of them is FF1. When the clock rises, its state settles in two steps, and Q flips on the first.
lines.tts: One of them is F F one. When the clock rises, its state settles in two steps, and queue flips on the first.

lines.sub: In SPICE, at 0.9 volts, its sequencing overhead is 2.53 times lower than a transmission-gate flip-flop's,
lines.tts: In spice, at zero point nine volts, its sequencing overhead is two point five three times lower than a transmission-gate flip-flop's,

lines.sub: B-Flex: a broader flip-flop design space, searched exhaustively.
lines.tts: Bee-Flex. A broader flip-flop design space, searched exhaustively.
